title: Make AA0194 an error in the base ruleset
summary: AA0194 code analysis rule is now enforced as an error instead of a warning in the base application ruleset, requiring all actions to have either an OnAction trigger or RunObject property.
key_points: AA0194 rule severity raised from warning to error in base ruleset
Requires all actions to specify OnAction trigger or RunObject property
Several pages were updated to comply with the stricter rule
Removes override configuration from ruleset file
Affects Finance VAT reporting pages and other modules
